acceptanceCriteria: Pundit policy classes resolve request->policy method->role for literal rules, with a finding naming the policy file:line
Unsupported libraries still return UNKNOWN with a closed reason
Fixture tests cover an authorized and an unauthorized Pundit pair
body: Residual of V1-1770 (PR #1121, GitHub #1115), which delivered the ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED analysis in internal/testsource/actor_auth*.go for Rails + CanCanCan with Playwright request.<verb>(literal path). Expected: Pundit policies (and other common authorization libraries) resolve the granting rule. Actual: any non-CanCanCan app gives UNKNOWN (ability-unavailable).
title: Actor-authorization analysis supports only CanCanCan; Pundit and other Rails auth libraries yield UNKNOWN
